criteria.requirement: Add a box mesh named `panel`, dimensions 4×2.4×0.3, centered at (0,1.4,0); its front faces +Z.
criteria.action: Inspect the initial scene graph, panel geometry parameters, world transform, and both label parent transforms.
criteria.expected: Panel has the specified dimensions and center; labels are its children at Z ±0.151, with back Y rotation π. (Tolerance: 1e-5)

criteria.requirement: Position x/y, Z rotation in degrees, and uniform scale apply to the corresponding label group; visibility controls both the group and its pickability.
criteria.expected: Local position is (0.4,-0.2,0.151), Z rotation is π/6, all scale components are 1.5, and the group is visible. (Tolerance: 1e-5)

criteria.requirement: Reject unknown keys, unknown sides, non-finite numbers, and invalid values: return false without changing state, scene, or storage.
criteria.action: Save a valid state, then attempt patches with scale 2.1, x NaN, an unknown key, and an invalid side.
criteria.expected: Every call returns false; serialized state, label transforms, and the stored JSON remain identical to their pre-attempt values. (Tolerance: exact state and storage equality)

criteria.requirement: `load()` validates every field and default-required key, then applies the state and updates all geometry, materials, textures, and visibility, returning true.
criteria.action: Save a customized two-sided state, change both sides and the base color, then call load() and inspect state and scene.
criteria.expected: load returns true and restores all saved values, including panel color, label transforms, text state, visibility, and selection. (Tolerance: 1e-5 for numeric transforms; exact otherwise)

criteria.requirement: A hit selects and returns that side (`front` or `back`); a miss returns null and leaves selection unchanged.
criteria.action: Project a visible front label center to client coordinates and pick it, then hide it and repeat, followed by a known empty-canvas pick.
criteria.expected: The visible hit returns and selects front; the hidden-label attempt and empty miss return null without changing selection. (Tolerance: projected center within 2 pixels)

criteria.requirement: `reset()` restores every default state value, rebuilds both label textures, restores the initial camera position and controls target, removes `plaqueStudio.v1`, and returns a deep copy of the default state without reloading the page.
criteria.action: Customize and save, move the camera, call reset(), mutate the returned object, and inspect application state, camera, and storage.
criteria.expected: All defaults and initial camera/target are restored, storage is absent, and mutating the returned copy does not alter application state. (Tolerance: 1e-5)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
